events.title: Hormuz still barely open; Brent ~$107
events.why_it_matters: Commercial transits remain a small fraction of the pre-war ~125 large vessels/day, keeping a war premium in G3 inflation and the Warsh extra-hike path.
events.what_to_watch: Daily commodity transits, war-risk premia, and any US-Iran mediator response after Trump rejected Iran's seven-day reopen roadmap.

events.title: China Mid-Autumn/Golden Week travel and market shutdown
events.why_it_matters: Only three mainland workdays (Sep 28-30) sit between holidays; A-shares/FX close Oct 1-7, so PMI and any risk-off must clear before the shutdown.
events.what_to_watch: Holiday travel/retail prints versus the old gasoline spike (already muted by EV/rail), and PBoC reverse-repo take-up.

events.title: PBoC up-to-RMB1tn/day holiday reverse repos
events.why_it_matters: Record-scale overnight RRPs from today through Oct 8 are meant to offset Golden Week and quarter-end cash demand, not a signal of an LPR cut.
events.what_to_watch: Daily operation size versus the 1tn cap, interbank rates into Oct 8 reopen, and whether LPR stays 3.00%/3.50% at the Oct 19-20 fixing.

events.title: BoJ July minutes (hawkish pre-1.25% hike)
events.why_it_matters: Minutes of the Jul 30-31 hold show members already debating faster hikes on oil/yen/wage pass-through, validating the Sep 18 move to 1.25%.
events.what_to_watch: JPY and JGB reaction today; Oct 1 Summary of Opinions from the hike meeting is the next live signal before Oct 29-30.

events.title: Teamsters expand Amazon warehouse pickets
events.why_it_matters: Union says pickets hit multiple FCs after a Sep 2 Riverside one-day ULP strike; Amazon's network can reroute, but peak-season delay risk is the market channel.
events.what_to_watch: Whether non-union sites honor lines, package-delay reports, and any NLRB/Cemex bargaining orders this week.

events.title: US Section 338 bans on selected Canadian goods
events.why_it_matters: Sep 8 proclamations convert parts of the 50% Canada tit-for-tat into outright bans on specified beer/wine/spirits, some whey, and >800cc motorcycles at 12:01 a.m. ET Sep 29.
events.what_to_watch: CBP enforcement of annex HTS lines, in-transit 50% duty treatment, and any Canadian counter-retaliation.

events.title: August JOLTS job openings
events.why_it_matters: Opens labor week into NFP; consensus ~7.2m after July's ~7.27m, a gauge of how much tightness the Warsh Fed still sees.
events.what_to_watch: Openings vs 7.2m, quits rate, and any freeze in hiring that would undercut ~65% Oct 28 hike odds.

events.title: Conference Board consumer confidence (September)
events.why_it_matters: Same-morning companion to JOLTS into PCE/NFP; oil at ~$107 and 7% mortgages are the downside risks to the labor-differential.
events.what_to_watch: Headline vs expectations/present-situation split and inflation expectations.

events.title: August PCE, personal income, Q2 GDP third estimate + NIPA revisions
events.why_it_matters: First post-Warsh-hike inflation print plus annual NIPA revisions; consensus clusters around core PCE +0.24-0.28% m/m and ~3.3% y/y, GDP third ~1.5-1.6%.
events.what_to_watch: Core PCE vs 0.25% m/m, whether revisions shave y/y, and GDI/corporate profits in the GDP third.

events.title: China September NBS PMI (pre-Golden Week)
events.why_it_matters: Last mainland print before the Oct 1-7 close; consensus sees manufacturing back to ~50.1-50.2 after August 49.8, with non-manufacturing still sub-50.
events.what_to_watch: Official mfg vs 50, new-export orders, and Caixin/RatingDog follow-through around Oct 1.

events.title: Micron FY Q4 2026 earnings
events.why_it_matters: Marquee AI/HBM print into a memory shortage; guide and HBM mix will reprice semis after SK Hynix/Samsung inventories fell below ~10 days.
events.what_to_watch: FY27 HBM/DRAM pricing commentary, capex, and any supply-constraint language into 2027.

events.title: FCC Open Meeting: unlock satellite spectrum
events.why_it_matters: Commission considers a Report and Order unlocking >1,000 MHz in 12.7 GHz and 42 GHz for FSS plus FNPRMs on more Ku/Ka/D-band satellite use.
events.what_to_watch: Final vote language on gateway/feeder-link rules and how aggressively the FNPRMs expand NGSO/GSO access.

events.title: ISM Manufacturing PMI (September)
events.why_it_matters: Factory gauge after August 54.6; consensus mid-54s to ~55, still expansion but a prices-paid spike would feed the Warsh hike path.
events.what_to_watch: Headline vs ~54.8, employment, and prices-paid versus oil-driven input costs.

events.title: Accenture FY26 Q4 earnings
events.why_it_matters: IT-services bellwether (consensus EPS ~$3.18) is a read-through on AI project conversion versus consulting slowdown.
events.what_to_watch: FY27 bookings/guide and generative-AI revenue commentary before the open.

events.title: Nike FY27 Q1 earnings
events.why_it_matters: Global consumer/China wholesale reset print (consensus EPS ~$0.44, sales ~$11.3bn) after a multi-quarter share-loss cycle.
events.what_to_watch: North America full-price mix, Greater China, and inventory/gross-margin guide after the close.

events.title: September nonfarm payrolls
events.why_it_matters: August was +162k; consensus now +90-110k and U-3 4.1-4.2%. A hot print cements ~64-66% Oct 28 hike odds; a miss revives the Warsh-overtightening debate.
events.what_to_watch: NFP vs ~100k, unemployment, average hourly earnings, and revisions.

events.title: Euro area September flash HICP
events.why_it_matters: First inflation print after the Sep 10 ECB 25 bp hike to 2.50% DF; August headline was 3.2-3.3% on energy +14.3%.
events.what_to_watch: Headline vs the 3.6% Q4 staff-projection peak path and core/services versus 2.4-2.5%.

events.title: OPEC+ monthly Joint Ministerial meeting
events.why_it_matters: Sep 6 hold left October quotas unchanged because Hormuz, not spare capacity, is the binding constraint; Oct 4 sets November policy and 2027 capacity-audit talk.
events.what_to_watch: Any quota change versus another hold, and language on Iran-war shut-ins versus 2027 baseline audits.

events.title: ISM Services PMI (September)
events.why_it_matters: Services are still the growth engine (August 55.4); consensus ~54.0, so a re-acceleration would support the extra-hike narrative into Oct 7 minutes.
events.what_to_watch: Headline vs 54, employment, and prices-paid.

events.title: IEEPA CAPE Phase 3 finally-liquidated refunds
events.why_it_matters: CBP starts Phase 3 on Oct 6 for CIT plaintiffs with reliquidation orders; DOJ still appeals universal finally-liquidated refunds at the Federal Circuit.
events.what_to_watch: Whether refunds stay plaintiff-only, any CAFC briefing surprise, and importer cash-flow commentary (Costco already booked a $0.15 IEEPA benefit).

events.title: Constellation Brands earnings
events.why_it_matters: Beer/spirits bellwether reports the same week US Section 338 Canadian alcohol bans bite and IEEPA refunds start, a read on US demand plus trade-cost mix.
events.what_to_watch: US beer depletion, Mexico supply, and any tariff/ban commentary after the close.

events.title: SK Hynix Nasdaq ADS 90-day lockup expiry
events.why_it_matters: July ADS listing lockup (~2.6m ADS / ~$0.5bn) lifts into a memory-shortage rally; overlapping mid-October buyback-program expiry adds supply-overhang risk.
events.what_to_watch: Actual affiliate selling versus a follow-on buyback announcement, and MU print two sessions earlier.

events.title: September FOMC minutes (Warsh 25 bp hike)
events.why_it_matters: Minutes of the Sep 15-16 unanimous hike to 3.75-4.00% will show how close the Committee is to another move at the Oct 27-28 non-SEP meeting.
events.what_to_watch: Dissent-free but hawkish color on oil, financial conditions, and whether another hike is the baseline.

events.title: PepsiCo Q3 2026 earnings
events.why_it_matters: Staples/pricing-power print into $107 oil and Canada alcohol bans; company already set Oct 8 BMO for the quarter ended Sep 5.
events.what_to_watch: Organic volume vs price/mix and FY guide before the open.

events.title: Delta Air Lines September-quarter earnings
events.why_it_matters: Airline bellwether is a direct read on jet-fuel (Hormuz) versus still-firm travel demand.
events.what_to_watch: CASM-ex/fuel, unit revenue, and 4Q capacity/fuel-hedge guide on the Oct 9 call.

events.title: Anthropic IPO marketing window
events.why_it_matters: Reuters sources shifted roadshow start to mid-October for a potentially mega-cap AI listing before midterms; still confidential, date can slip.
events.what_to_watch: S-1 de-confidentialization, valuation talk versus $2tn chatter, and whether Q3 numbers delay the launch past this window.

events.title: Trump-Xi White House summit; truce to Jan 10 2027
events.why_it_matters: Bessent's two-month extension removes the Nov 10 tariff-cliff tail and adds coal/ag working groups, but no broader deal on rare earths, AI, or Taiwan.
events.what_to_watch: Follow-through on the $30bn nonsensitive-goods tariff-cut list and the November AI dialogue / APEC Shenzhen meeting.

events.title: US-Iran UNGA shuttle talks fail to reopen Hormuz
events.why_it_matters: First contact in months was called constructive, but Iran's seven-day plan demanded end-blockade/sanctions/asset unfreeze; Trump rejected it, so oil stays headline-driven.
events.what_to_watch: Qatar/Pakistan mediator traffic and any US counter-offer after UNGA week ends.

events.title: 80 countries demand Hormuz reopening at UNGA
events.why_it_matters: Bahrain-led GCC-plus-West statement condemns Iranian/Houthi interference and demands unimpeded transit with no tolls — pressure without a reopen.
events.what_to_watch: Whether the coalition expands or tables a UNSC follow-up to Resolution 2817.

events.title: Trump-Zelenskyy UNGA energy/Black Sea truce push
events.why_it_matters: A limited energy-infrastructure pause would ease the diesel crunch from Russian refinery hits, but Moscow still wants sanctions relief and no deal was announced.
events.what_to_watch: Whether strikes on refineries/grids actually pause; they had not as of late September.

events.title: Graham Russia/Iran Act; 100% secondary-tariff clock
events.why_it_matters: P.L. 119-111 requires up-to-100% tariffs on top buyers of Russian crude/gas that keep buying, with presidential implementation due by ~Oct 18 — a live CN/IN trade channel.
events.what_to_watch: USTR/White House country determinations and any waiver for EU gas or Indian crude before the 30-day clock.

events.title: BoJ hikes to 1.25%, highest since 1995
events.why_it_matters: 7-2 hike on oil, wages, and yen; next meeting Oct 29-30 with an Outlook Report is outside this window but the Sep minutes/SOP still reprice JGBs/USDJPY.
events.what_to_watch: Oct 1 Summary of Opinions and whether markets price another 25 bp in October.

events.title: Google ad-tech remedy: behavioral only, AdX not divested
events.why_it_matters: Unsealed Brinkema opinion (ruling Sep 2) spares AdX, orders interoperability/non-discrimination for six years — relief for GOOGL, negative for ad-tech plaintiffs.
events.what_to_watch: Google's liability appeal and 60-day/12-15 month implementation clocks; not a near-term price catalyst unless DOJ seeks a stay.

events.title: Costco Q4 FY26 beat; IEEPA refund tailwind
events.why_it_matters: EPS $6.75 vs ~$6.54, comps +9.4%; $0.15 from IEEPA refunds is a live template for other importers ahead of CAPE Phase 3.
events.what_to_watch: Whether peers also guide refunds as they hit Phase 3 on Oct 6.

events.title: FY2027 CR already law through Dec 11
events.why_it_matters: H.R. 6500 / P.L. 119-103 was signed Sep 2, so the Oct 1 funding cliff is not live; next fight is the Dec 11 lame-duck CR. Debt limit is a 2027 issue.
events.what_to_watch: Nothing this window; ignore shutdown headlines until mid-November.

events.title: HBM/DRAM inventories below ~10 days at KR majors
events.why_it_matters: Samsung/SK Hynix stockpiles under 10 days as HBM4 eats capacity is the fundamental behind MU and the SKHY lockup; not a weather story.
events.what_to_watch: MU guide Sep 30 and any 2027 contract-price commentary from KR names.

top_risks: Hormuz stays closed / talks stay dead: Brent ~$107 keeps G3 inflation sticky and supports another Warsh hike.
Hot Aug PCE (Wed) and/or Sep NFP (Fri) lock in ~65% odds of a 25 bp hike on Oct 28.
Graham Act secondary-tariff determinations hit China/India crude buyers before the ~Oct 18 clock.
Canada Section 338 bans (Tue) plus still-live 50% duties add a North American consumer/industrial friction tax.
China PMI miss into Golden Week shutdown leaves CN risk untradeable until Oct 8.
top_opportunities: Any credible Hormuz reopen path (even a monitored corridor) would crush the oil/inflation premium.
Soft core PCE and/or sub-consensus NFP would reprice Oct 28 hike odds down from ~2/3.
Micron FQ4 (Wed AMC) as the cleanest AI-memory upside expression of the KR inventory squeeze.
IEEPA CAPE Phase 3 cash (Oct 6) is a real importer tailwind; Costco already showed the EPS template.
Trump-Xi truce to Jan 10 2027 still removes the Nov 10 tariff cliff even without a grand bargain.
summary: The Sep 24 Trump-Xi pageant extended the trade truce to Jan 10 2027 and removed the Nov 10 cliff, but it did not de-risk the tape: Hormuz is still barely open (Brent ~$107, single-digit daily transits), UNGA diplomacy produced no deal, and prediction markets still price roughly two-thirds odds of another 25 bp Warsh hike on Oct 28. This window's live catalysts are Canada Section 338 bans (Sep 29), labor/PCE week (Sep 29-Oct 2), China PMI into Golden Week (Sep 30), Micron (Sep 30), and the Oct 4 OPEC+ meeting — not a US shutdown, which is already funded through Dec 11.
